name: io.github.jordanspilgrim/plume
description: The human pane for agentic coding. Open files in the Plume editor, read the user's selection and their typed steering directives (approve/reject/revise/question/pin), and write revisions the user reviews as an accept/reject diff.

tools.name: open_in_plume
tools.description: Open a file (optionally at a line) and bring it to the front.

tools.name: get_active_document
tools.description: Path + full text of what the user is viewing, incl. unsaved edits.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: The user's current selection with its line range.

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: The user's typed steering directives on quoted passages.

tools.name: write_document
tools.description: Write a revision; the user reviews it as an accept/reject diff.

tools.name: get_attachments
tools.description: Files the user pushed to this project's agent from Plume.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.install: Install Plume, then run `claude mcp add plume -- plume-mcp` (or `codex mcp add` / `gemini mcp add`). Until @plume/mcp is published to npm, plume-mcp ships with the Plume app (File ▸ Install 'plume' Shell Command…).
